case_transfer_cards.transfer: Use a shared district interface so facilities, mobility trials and operators can be reviewed against one versioned service contract.
case_transfer_cards.do_not_transfer: Do not transfer sensor counts, platform procurement, governance authority or claimed outcomes to Haidian.

case_transfer_cards.transfer: Use a public digital-twin workspace to compare scenarios and expose assumptions before physical changes.
case_transfer_cards.do_not_transfer: Do not transfer citywide coverage, data-monitoring powers or simulation accuracy claims.

case_transfer_cards.transfer: Start a bounded street trial from a documented city need and pair field measurements with resident and operator feedback.
case_transfer_cards.do_not_transfer: A trial is not a procurement, operating permission or evidence that the same service works in Haidian.

case_transfer_cards.transfer: Treat mobility as an iterative human-centred test course with explicit learning and revision cycles.
case_transfer_cards.do_not_transfer: Do not import private-campus governance, brand language, land control or corporate operating authority.

case_transfer_cards.transfer: Accept the whole trip across organizations, including first and last links, human assistance and accessibility.
case_transfer_cards.do_not_transfer: Do not transfer U.S. funding, institutions, accessibility compliance findings or programme outcomes.

case_transfer_cards.transfer: Phase a small-area first/last-mile service and involve frontline operators when specifying delivery and procurement.
case_transfer_cards.do_not_transfer: Do not transfer ridership, cost, fleet, service area or contractual assumptions.

identity_direction.mark: two separable loops and one switch
identity_direction.public_loop: a continuous public path that remains usable without an enterprise or platform account
identity_direction.service_loop: a reversible mobility service that may be frozen or withdrawn
identity_direction.switch: visible handoff among automated recommendation, staffed service and public-transport fallback
identity_direction.approval_boundary: Candidate wayfinding direction only; not the formal Jing-Zhang Belt identity and not approved for installation.

component_catalogue.daily_use: staffed arrival information plus de-identified stop, repair and next-review records
show which of seven trip links remains broken, who receives it and the next review date

component_catalogue.mapped_anchor: Dazhongsi station is an external public-transfer anchor outside the current PROV-KEY-003 rough rectangle
component_catalogue.daily_use: compare rail, bus, walking, wheelchair, staffed service and curb states on one readable board

grammar: railway timekeeping: service window, last verified update and next review
switch arrows: automated, staffed and public-transport paths remain visually separable
public receipt: every change displays receiver, stop condition and closure evidence
bilingual high-contrast language with pictograms, tactile/audio options and no phone-only entry
cultural_signage_system.heritage_boundary: Railway timekeeping is a narrative grammar, not a historical-fact claim; historians, accessibility reviewers and visual designers must review content before installation.

consented barrier log, non-participant count and repair receiver

annual_operating_calendar.focus: rain, heat, event and curb-conflict drill

independent replay and explicit continue, repair or withdraw decision
